thought.text: Venice punya **model uncensored khusus** (`venice-uncensored-1-2`, murah $0.20/$0.90) dan 143 model. Ini kandidat kuat. Saya cek model uncensored-nya semua dan apakah ada free tier.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 -c "
import json;d=json.load(open('/tmp/ve.json'))['data']
un=[m for m in d if any(k in m['id'].lower() for k in ['uncens','ablit','dolphin','hermes','heretic','unfilter','nsfw','venice'])]
print('UNCENSORED di Venice:',len(un))
for m in un:
    p=m.get('model_spec',{}).get('pricing',{})
    print(f\"  {m['id']:45} in={p.get('input',{}).get('usd')} out={p.get('output',{}).get('usd')}\")
"; echo "=== free tier / trial Venice ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 "https://venice.ai/" -o /tmp/vh.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; grep -oiE "(free|trial|\\\$[0-9]+|credit)[^<]{0,60}" /tmp/vh.html 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -8
